_comment: Accepted high/critical advisories in PRODUCTION dependencies. Read by scripts/audit-prod.js, which runs in CI. Every entry needs a reason and a reviewBy date; the build fails once reviewBy passes, and again if the entry stops matching anything. Do not add an entry to silence a finding that has a patched version available - upgrade instead.

allow.reason: Build tooling only, never shipped. Every path is expo > @expo/cli / @expo/metro-config / @expo/metro (metro-file-map, jest-util, micromatch) or react-native > tinyglobby, which RN uses only in its codegen build scripts. The ReDoS needs an attacker-controlled glob pattern; these tools only match patterns from our own Metro/codegen config, never user input. Not imported by app code and absent from the C# API and the compiled RN bundles. Advisory range was widened on 2026-11-17 to '<= 4.0.7' (covers both installed copies, 2.3.2 and 4.0.7) with no patched release.
